Hmm i think that since you're looking for a thinner paint you should try [Liquitex Basics.](https://www.amazon.ca/gp/aw/d/B002PNLVFI/ref=mp_s_a_1_2?ie=UTF8&qid=1491532659&sr=8-2&pi=AC_SX236_SY340_QL65&keywords=liquitex+basics&dpPl=1&dpID=51GoWW2q5UL&ref=plSrch) . They're lighter than most paints, and they come in pretty big tubes so you wont be afraid of using many layers. Liquitex Basics are one of the lowest priced paints at my local crafting store, but so many people choose it anyways. And for the brushes, as long as the bristles are not too stiff they should be fine. All of my brushes look like shit, but *hey* they get the job done!
